spec.description: GPU fleet observability built from the openlit opentelemetry-gpu-collector metrics: utilization, memory, power, energy (kWh), thermal, ECC/PCIe errors and CUDA kernel activity.

spec.expr: avg by (gpu_index, hw_gpu_task) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{hw_gpu_task=~"encoder|decoder", service_name=~"$application", deployment_environment=~"$environment", host_name=~"$host", gpu_index=~"$gpu"})

avg by (host_name, gpu_index, hw_name) (avg_over_time(hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{hw_gpu_task="general", service_name=~"$application", deployment_environment=~"$environment", host_name=~"$host", gpu_index=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))

hw_gpu_memory_usage_bytes{service_name=~"$application", deployment_environment=~"$environment", host_name=~"$host", gpu_index=~"$gpu"} 
/ hw_gpu_memory_limit_bytes{service_name=~"$application", deployment_environment=~"$environment", host_name=~"$host", gpu_index=~"$gpu"}

spec.title: Clock Frequencies
spec.description: Graphics (SM) and memory clocks. Stored in MHz; multiplied to Hz for auto-scaled display.

spec.title: Error Rate by Type
spec.description: hw_errors_total split by error_type: corrected (ECC), uncorrected (ECC), pcie_replay. Any uncorrected errors are serious.

spec.expr: sum by (gpu_index, error_type) (rate(hw_errors_total{service_name=~"$application", deployment_environment=~"$environment", host_name=~"$host", gpu_index=~"$gpu"}[5m]))
sum by (gpu_index, error_type) (increase(hw_errors_total{service_name=~"$application", deployment_environment=~"$environment", host_name=~"$host", gpu_index=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Kernel Launch Rate
spec.description: gpu_kernel_launch_calls_total (cudaLaunchKernel uprobe). Host-scoped; only present when eBPF tracing is enabled and a CUDA workload runs.

spec.title: Average Kernel Grid / Block Size (threads)
spec.description: Histogram average = rate(_sum)/rate(_count) for gpu_kernel_grid_size and gpu_kernel_block_size.

spec.expr: count((avg by (hw_id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{hw_gpu_task="general", service_name=~"$application", deployment_environment=~"$environment", host_name=~"$host", gpu_index=~"$gpu"})) < 0.1) or vector(0)

spec.title: GPU Compute Utilization (SM)
spec.description: NVML SM utilization (hw_gpu_task=general). Low values over time indicate underutilized / wasted GPUs.

spec.expr: avg by (host_name, gpu_index, hw_name) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{hw_gpu_task="general", service_name=~"$application", deployment_environment=~"$environment", host_name=~"$host", gpu_index=~"$gpu"})

spec.title: GPU Memory Bandwidth Utilization
spec.description: NVML memory controller utilization (bandwidth), distinct from capacity used.

spec.expr: avg by (gpu_index, hw_name) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{hw_gpu_task="general", service_name=~"$application", deployment_environment=~"$environment", host_name=~"$host", gpu_index=~"$gpu"})

spec.title: OpenLIT GPU Observability

spec.name: prometheus_datasource
spec.label: Data source
spec.description: Prometheus-compatible data source holding GPU metrics (VictoriaMetrics)
